disclosed_third_change_writer_zero_survi.why: the card's negative control requires a 0-survivor fixture to stay REFUSED with a reason naming 0 survivors. Empirically that refusal did not exist: with band-correct 0-survivor bytes the writer WROTE an empty bundle (control B below), and the pre-fix refusal only happened by accident through the band mismatch. Fixing only the engine would therefore have flipped 0-survivor F rounds from 'refused' to 'empty bundle written' - a fail-open the parent card's closeout explicitly rules out ('0 survivor -> 依 §10.8 不寫 survivor bundle').
